author.headline: She gave the unknown a voice.
author.role: Author of *Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus*
author.bio: Daughter of Mary Wollstonecraft and William Godwin, Shelley grew up among radical ideas. A ghost-story challenge at Lake Geneva in 1816 became *Frankenstein*, begun when she was eighteen and published anonymously two years later.

quote.text: It was on a dreary night of November that I beheld the accomplishment of my toils.
